obligations.result: PASS with two fidelity gaps (N1, N2)
obligations.evidence: Gate 2: README-style thermal_comfort in the installed venv interpreter (conftest.py API_SCRIPT:323-341 + installed_api_run fixture:344-369; test_installed_noenv_gates.py:58-80) and a real console-script run (installed_cli_run fixture:372-422; test:108-118) -- the child env is built from scratch by child_env (installed_test_helpers.py:78-98), so no PYTHONPATH can be inherited; the installed venv lives outside the repo under pytest tmp. Gate 3: backend vars absent by construction (documented BACKEND_ENV_VARS, literal env dict), PATH=/usr/bin:/bin (CHILD_PATH), native dev cache chmod 0o555 with before/after listing asserted empty (conftest _run_noenv_pipeline:273-278; assertions test:76-77,117), Numba JIT cache and scene outputs the only writable destinations. Gate 5: test_source_fallback_gates.py:89-95 (source install under stripped PATH, no ispc/c-compiler tokens in install log), :98-113 (preprocess+calculate_svf on Numba with GDAL-verified SVF output), :116-123 (console script). Gate 7: test_wheel_ships_no_torch_cuda_code (test_installed_wheel_gates.py:73-99) bans torch/cuda/nvidia payload names, compares Requires-Dist canonically (name + sorted specifier clauses) to the frozen surface, and runs dx_snapshot.check_forbidden_core_dependencies; real own-met scene (SCENE/met.txt via own_met_file). GAP N1: site-packages is never made nonwritable (PACKAGING_AND_DISTRIBUTION.md:43 'Make site-packages and native dev-cache nonwritable'; DX_CONTRACT gate 3) -- only the native dev cache is. GAP N2: 'no network attempt originating from the backend' is structural (offline wheelhouse, pip --no-index, local files only), not enforced or monitored -- nothing would detect a socket attempt during model execution.

Fresh venvs are created by uv under pytest tmp outside the repo (evidence JSON paths /private/var/folders/.../work/{wheelenv,sourceenv}; no path under REPO_ROOT). Module-origin honesty is enforced by two independent mechanisms: child-side sweep of every imported solweig_light* module in sys.modules after the real run (API_SCRIPT:336-340; source smoke:65-69), and parent-side pkgutil.walk_packages import of the whole installed package with an explicit '/src/solweig_light' origin ban (test_installed_wheel_gates.py:105-121), plus surface-capture package_path asserted in site-packages (:139-140). Wheelhouse pinning cannot silently pick wrong versions: RUNTIME_CLOSURE pins 12 exact name==version pairs (wheelhouse.py:32-45); _find_archive matches Name+Version read from each uv-cache entry's dist-info METADATA (:111-114) with a platform-tag filter (:116-120); verify_wheel re-reads METADATA inside the repacked zip (:154-165); pip's own RECORD-hash verification at install time backstops byte fidelity of the repack. env -i semantics are real: child_env constructs a literal 5-key dict (HOME/PATH/NUMBA_CACHE_DIR/SOLWEIG_LIGHT_NATIVE_CACHE/LANG); no os.environ copy or update from parent, so parent variables cannot leak (HOME is the one deliberate inherit, in the documented allowlist).

NOT-native-qualified labelling is everywhere it should be: module docstrings of all three executable test files, the NOT_NATIVE_QUALIFIED constant asserted inside two source-gate tests, GATE_RECORD mode_label (quoting DX_CONTRACT's necessary-but-insufficient line), README boundary section, evidence JSON. Deferred skips carry exact owner task IDs ([native-wheel-deferred-N8-41], [companion-collision-deferred-N8-41], [upstream-collision-deferred-N8-42], [native-qualification-deferred-N8-42]) duplicated in the conftest sessionfinish deferred list. [host-memory-pressure] is honest: both gates recorded 3 attempts, each with the full ResourceAdmissionError line and its exact numbers (reviewer rerun: needs 1,736,017,587 B, parent 429,496,730 B, budget 1,696,022,528 B; author evidence: budgets 1,628-1,746 MB across six attempts), retried at 20 s spacing by code (conftest:281-307), never converted to a pass, and the skip message embeds the admission note. Admission arithmetic for the pass-on-idle claim: pass requires budget >= needs + parent = 2,165,514,317 B, i.e. host available view >= 4,331,028,634 B (~4.33 GB) -- matching the author's '>=4.3 GB'; observed host views were 3.26-3.49 GB under team load, a 0.85-1.1 GB shortfall, so an idle host with >=8.7 GB available passes with >=2x margin. PLAUSIBLE but the gate stays UNPROVEN until the coordinator's quiet-host rerun completes a full run and the TMRT/UTCI output assertions actually execute. Bounded partial credit is already real: stdout tails show preprocess + SVF completed and the Numba JIT cache in the installed venv was populated (4 entries) before the utci-phase refusal, and the native cache stayed empty -- but the output-set/band-count assertions were never reached. Context (N5): the refusing check itself is the branch's own C6-42 parent-side phase admission (dx_divergences.md item 2); main would not refuse under the same load -- 'baseline resource-admission model' is accurate for this branch, and the quiet-host rerun remains the decisive test.

The capture genuinely runs in subprocess origin against the installed venv: test_installed_wheel_gates.py:138 calls dx_snapshot.capture_runtime_surface_subprocess(wheel_venv['python']), which spawns the venv interpreter with only the dx directory inserted (dx_snapshot.py:606-622) so 'import solweig_light' resolves to installed site-packages; the parent's modules are never imported there. The claimed env-var form SOLWEIG_DX_PACKAGE_ORIGIN=subprocess:<python> exists and parses the same path (tests/optimization_v8/dx/test_dx_surface.py:56-62). 'Zero unexpected divergences' is enforced with teeth: surface_divergences flat-compares 16 asserted-leaf groups with a <missing> sentinel (dx_snapshot.py:629-678), and check_divergences_called with an EMPTY allowlist plus baseline+branch cross-check (:681-734) means any drift at all fails, stale entries fail, and allowlisted values must equal a real main-vs-branch source divergence. Reviewer recomputed the frozen main-vs-branch asserted-leaf drift independently: empty ([]) -- so the empty allowlist is correct, not a bypass. The 27-flag claim verified against main_surface.json (27 CLI options); the --help gate asserts set equality in both directions (test_installed_noenv_gates.py:94-101) and --version matches 'solweig_light 0.1.0.dev0' (:102-105).
